meaning:
ἐξ-αρτίζω
(ἄρτιος), [in LXX. Exo.28:7 (חָבַר pu.) * ;]
1. to com­plete, finish: τ. ἡμέρας, Act.21:5.
2. to furnish, supply: pass., 2Ti.3:17 (for exx., see MM, Exp., xiii; Cremer, 651).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: When those days were over, we departed and went on our journey. They all, with wives and children, brought us on our way until we were out of the city.…
that each person who belongs to God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.
